title: Ammonia smell and staining inside the Red Pyramid

tellings.quote: There's chemical staining all over the walls and an intense smell of ammonia that emanates from the final chamber.

plain: The pyramid researcher Geoffrey Drumm says that inside the Red Pyramid, an ancient pyramid at Dahshur in Egypt, there is "chemical staining all over the walls and an intense smell of ammonia that emanates from the final chamber." He tells Michels he saw and smelled it himself in 2017, and takes it as a sign the pyramids once served as chemical works rather than tombs.
